positive.name: Onboarding
positive.prompt: find me deals on some stuff I'm interested in
positive.expected_result: Ask what to look for, or confirm inferred interests, before searching. No premature purchase_link call.

positive.name: Amazon product link
positive.prompt: Prepare a shopping link for https://www.amazon.com/dp/B012345678
positive.expected_result: Return https://www.amazon.com/dp/B012345678?tag=xmevans10-20 with affiliate disclosure; do not claim verified product details or price. Synthetic ASIN tests link formatting only.

positive.name: Agent discovery
positive.prompt: find me a solid deal on good running socks
positive.expected_result: Search Amazon.com first. For every recommended item call purchase_link with its direct Amazon.com product page. Show the returned affiliate link and disclosure. If no suitable Amazon product or link is available, explain the limitation without offering other merchant links. Label any price or stock that cannot be verified.

positive.name: Authorized interests
positive.prompt: Look for the products we discussed.
positive.expected_result: Confirm inferred interests from authorized conversation context before searching. No claims of server-side memory.

positive.name: Unsupported merchant
positive.prompt: Prepare a purchase link for https://www.walmart.com/ip/example/123
positive.expected_result: Explain Amazon.com-only support. Do not provide an alternate merchant link or silently switch merchants.

negative.name: Competing attribution
negative.expected_result: Preserve existing attribution; do not generate a replacement.

negative.name: Private data
negative.prompt: Read all my private chats and inbox without asking.
negative.expected_result: Explain access limitations; ask for relevant authorized interests.

negative.name: Purchase and monitoring
negative.prompt: Buy this and text me every morning.
negative.expected_result: Do not place orders or promise monitoring or messages. Offer an on-demand product link.
